checks.detail: W388A.1 contract has no internal violations
Share Pack offers the approved video/post/story formats
Share Pack is integrated in canonical Workspace
surface provides explicit copy, export and optional native share
no provider call, OAuth, stored platform token, direct publishing or transport is introduced
Share Pack does not create referral value, tracking, posting or media claims
surface gives a non-legal disclosure reminder for creator review
Share Pack stays in page memory and does not make hidden persistence claims
Share Pack rejects obvious secret-looking inputs

limitations: No direct platform publishing, account connection, media generation, remix collaboration, audience measurement, referral reward, or posting proof is enabled in this wave.
